channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Logical Take | When Obsession Turns Fatal: The Indore Murder and the Crisis of Possessive Violence
item.description: The alleged killing of a 24-year-old MBA student inside a rented flat in Indore highlights how emotional insecurity and toxic possessiveness within relationships can escalate into tragic violence.

item.title: Sold as Junk, Returned with Honour: Faridabad Scrap Dealer Gives Back Rs 15 Lakh Gold After 4 Months
item.description: A Faridabad scrap dealer returned 100 grams of gold jewellery worth Rs 15 lakh after discovering it months after it was accidentally sold during a Diwali clean-up.

item.title: AI Summit 2026 Disrupted: 10 IYC Workers Detained After Shirtless Protest Over Jobs And Inflation
item.description: Youth Congress workers were detained after staging a shirtless protest inside Bharat Mandapam, alleging unemployment, inflation and economic distress during the India AI Impact Summit 2026.

item.title: AI May Disrupt 90 Million Jobs Globally, Create 170 Million New Roles: Says Infosys Chairman
item.description: Infosys Chairman Nandan Nilekani cautions that while AI could displace 90 million jobs worldwide, it may simultaneously create 170 million new opportunities, urging urgent reskilling and inclusive policy reforms.

item.title: Why the US Supreme Court Struck Down Trump’s Tariffs in a 6–3 Ruling: All You Need to Know
item.description: The ruling invalidates most 2025 emergency tariffs while reaffirming that only Congress can levy import taxes.

item.title: After 6–3 Supreme Court Verdict, Trump Signs 10% Global Tariff to Sustain Trade Push
item.description: Following a Supreme Court ruling limiting his tariff powers, President Donald Trump invoked a 1974 trade law to impose a temporary 10% global import duty, reigniting debate over executive authority and global trade stability.

item.title: A Classroom Meant For Learning Turns Fatal: 5-Year-Old Dies In Rajasthan School Structure Collapse
item.description: A temporary classroom structure reportedly collapsed during school hours, triggering protests and an official investigation into safety lapses.

item.title: People of Purpose: How Kuldeep Dantewadia Grew Reap Benefit Into a Movement of Over 1.2 Lakh Solve Ninjas
item.description: India's non-competitive youth festival unites 1,500+participants today in Bengaluru for hands-on changemaking across Connect, Learn, and Play.

item.title: 32 Fake Universities Exposed by University Grants Commission Across India, Delhi Tops the List
item.description: The UGC has warned students and parents to verify credentials after identifying 32 unauthorised universities whose degrees are legally invalid.

item.title: ‘We Did a Flip’: Donald Trump Claims US No Longer To Pay Tariffs to India, Says After 6–3 Supreme Court Ruling
item.description: Even after the US Supreme Court limited his tariff powers, former President Donald Trump insists the interim trade arrangement keeps India paying 10 per cent duties while negotiations continue.
